scientific.integrity: The motivating open PDF was inspected at the Euler derivation, endemic equilibrium and Jacobian, all three strong-resonance examples, the one-parameter phase portraits, and the global two-parameter diagram including its initial condition. The predecessor Euler-SIR paper was inspected at its unit-circle bifurcation formula and numerical bifurcation setup. Dynamically consistent SIR discretization literature and a later nonstandard-discrete SIR resonance paper were checked to delimit the claim. The bundled exact-arithmetic verifier replays the source-rounded witness and the universal determinant identity. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem distinguishes global epidemiological positivity from local polynomial-map bifurcation. It does not invalidate local normal-form calculations near the positive endemic fixed point, and h(d+r)<=1 is only a necessary infected-positivity condition near S=0 rather than a complete positivity criterion for the full Euler map.

title: Strong resonances of the Euler SIR map lie beyond its positivity barrier
